note: Added an allow-list for sortBy inside the patients search handler. The shared buildQuery() helper in src/lib/db/queryBuilder.ts was not changed and still concatenates identifiers.
Added requireRecordOwner() middleware in src/middleware/authz.ts and applied it to every /api/records/* route; ownership is checked against the session's patientId.
Moved the key to the STRIPE_SECRET_KEY environment variable, rotated the live key in Stripe and purged it from git history. No secret scanning was added to CI.
Login errors now return a generic message; stack traces are only logged server-side.
returnTo is now validated against an allow-list of internal paths.
The session cookie is now set with HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax.
Added per-number and per-IP attempt limits on OTP verification, with a 15-minute lockout after five failed codes.
The request logger now redacts bodies and only records route, status code and a request id.
Uploads are restricted to PDF, PNG and JPEG by file signature, renamed to random ids and served from a separate storage domain as attachments.
Allow-listed groupBy in the reports export handler. buildQuery() still concatenates identifiers for every other caller.
Sessions now expire after 12 hours of inactivity and are revoked on password change.
FHIR server URLs must match an allow-list of registered EHR vendors; private address ranges are rejected.
Replaced the phone regex with libphonenumber-js parsing.
The appointment endpoint now maps rows through a response DTO that omits internal notes.
